speaker.name: Lalit
speaker.origin: river village, known as a joker

segments.text: yem savi mi hulmar sorai balen.
segments.interviewer_gloss: One day I called the headman 'sorai'.
Everyone laughed. The headman did not laugh.
[Interviewer comment, English] Calling a superior 'sorai' is like calling him 'boy'. It is cheeky - funny if you are very close, insulting otherwise.
